title: Product Strategy & Development Associate II
description:
If you have what it takes to become part of the Vistra family and would like to start a promising career with a global leader, take a look at the exciting employment opportunities that are currently available and apply online.

Job Summary

Job Description
Overview:

- Vistra is one of the largest competitive electricity providers in the country and takes an innovative, customer-centric approach to meet customers' needs. To win the customer of the future, our Energy Transition Solutions team creates the strategy and builds the products that turn today's emerging energy technologies into real solutions

- In this role, you’ll leverage Distributed Energy Resources – EVs, home solar, whole-home batteries, and more – to create products, programs, and services that unlock new value for consumers and strengthen the grid

- You’ll own concepts from whiteboard to market launch: ideation, economic modeling, vendor partnerships and operational rollout of new products from virtual power plants to electricity commodity plans

- It’s a hands-on role that mixes analysis, creative problem solving, and day-to-day execution. You’ll collaborate across marketing, technology, operations and finance plus a diverse set of vendors from technology providers to global device manufacturers

Responsibilities:

- Leverage analytical and financial analysis skills to assess the commercial viability of potential offerings and recommend program designs that meet necessary financial metrics (margin, sales, ROI, etc.)

- Transform complex energy ideas to simple, easy to understand customer offerings

- Generate new concepts through proven ideation methodologies and opportunistic thinking

- Understand your target audience, analyze research insights & trends, identify opportunities, and ultimately propose & deliver products/programs/partnerships

- Lead the implementation of new products through ideation, program design, and market launch which will require working with cross-functional stakeholders

- Manage key product verticals and support product optimization (product design, marketing and sales tactics/strategy) to achieve sales goals for new products

- External partner relationship cultivation and management to define new programs & business models, negotiate commercial agreements, and define & execute the go-to-market workplan

Requirements:

- 5+ years work experience in retail-focused product development, offer/channel strategy, marketing or related function

- 3+ years with financial modeling or customer margin analysis (related to above)

- Experience with energy or alternative energy products (solar, battery, EVs, VPPs, Demand Response) strongly preferred

- Proficiency in excel based modeling required, SAS/Tableau experience beneficial; willingness and ability to learn new systems as required (e.g., CRM tools)

- Experience gained through college degree programs and/or certifications is applicable to above skills

- Requires strong sense of self-motivation, thrives under minimal supervision, excels at solving complex problems and enjoys working around obstacles

- Extensive communication and teamwork skills to work effectively with both internal and external customers (e.g., vendors, Marketing, Sales, IT, Legal, Operations, Finance)

- Demonstrate a high level of curiosity, a capacity for learning, and an aptitude for problem solving

- Able to effectively contribute to and/or lead small work groups

Key Metrics:

- Hit target goals for product launches, pilots and tests

- Plan, lead and launch key initiatives in a matrixed environment

- Realize product targets for sales velocity, retention, and/or profitability

- Achieve product / partner targets for customer satisfaction, complaints, incidents and escalations

title: BI, Analytics & AI Specialist
description:
If you have what it takes to become part of the Vistra family and would like to start a promising career with a global leader, take a look at the exciting employment opportunities that are currently available and apply online.

Job Summary
As a BI, Analytics & AI Specialist, you will partner with cross-functional leaders to uncover, activate, and optimize growth opportunities. You will transform raw energy market and customer data into strategic, automated insights that drive millions in revenue impact while democratizing data access across the organization through natural language querying, self-service dashboards, bespoke analysis, and machine learning.
This role will provide expertise in the following areas of the business:

• Design and deliver AI-powered interactive dashboards using generative BI capabilities (natural language queries, automated insight generation) and performance reporting that enable real-time decision-making across retail portfolios.

• Conduct deep-dive analyses to optimize customer lifecycle value through acquisition analytics, pricing optimization, churn modeling and assessment, customer engagement analytics, and advanced testing and measurement solutions.

• Champion adoption of emerging AI/ML tools and methodologies, staying current with generative BI innovations (e.g., AI-assisted data preparation, automated anomaly detection, conversational analytics) to maintain Vistra's analytical competitive edge.

• Mentor and develop junior analysts, fostering a culture of continuous learning and analytical excellence.

Job Description
Key Accountabilities

- Lead implementation of BI and AI-enhanced initiatives that identify profitable growth opportunities and optimize portfolio performance across Vistra's retail energy and customer markets, directly influencing pricing strategies and customer acquisition and retention initiatives.

- Own end-to-end BI solution development utilizing Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, generative BI tools, or other programming languages  to build executive dashboards and operational reports that enable stakeholders to make faster, data-driven decisions.

- Translate complex energy usage, pricing, customer profile and behavior data into clear, actionable recommendations for Pricing, Portfolio Management, Finance, Marketing, and Customer Experience teams and channels.

- Lead in-depth descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analysis of portfolio performance and uncover root causes for trends in channel gains, portfolio and customer lifecycle losses, transactional margin performance, portfolio and product mix outcomes, turning findings into automated alerts and strategic action plans.

- Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry best practices in BI.

- Lead evaluation and implementation of AI-enhanced BI platforms including generative analytics tools that enable natural language data exploration, automated insight surfacing, and predictive recommendations for business stakeholders.

- Provide thought leadership and mentorship to team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning, innovation and collaboration.

Education, Experience, & Skill Requirements

- Bachelor's Degree with 5+ years (or Master's with 3+ years, or equivalent 8+ years) of professional experience in data analysis or a related field.

- Extensive experience in analyzing large volumes of data using Python, SQL, SAS, R or similar programming languages. Experience collaborating with data engineering and data science teams to define requirements, integrate ML model outputs into BI dashboards, and navigate ambiguous business problems.

- Experience using Power BI or Tableau for data visualization. Exposure to GenBI and the ability to build it from the ground up.

- Demonstrated expertise building production dashboards in Power BI or Tableau for executives and audience personas across the organization. Exposure to and hands-on experience with generative BI/AI-enhanced analytics tools (e.g. Power BI Copilot, Tableau Pulse, or similar platforms) including natural language query design and automated insight configuration preferred.

- Web analytics experience with working knowledge of web analytics tools such as Adobe or Google Analytics.

- Hands-on experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and multivariate experiments to optimize pricing strategies, marketing campaigns, and customer experience initiatives.

- Solid understanding of financial modeling and investment analysis (ROI, CLV).

- Strategic thinker who balances analytical rigor with business pragmatism, excelling in cross-functional collaboration with business and technical stakeholders.

- Familiarity with AI/ML concepts applied to business analytics including predictive modeling, supervised/unsupervised learning, feature engineering, and model interpretation for business stakeholders.

Key Metrics

- Proactively learns business drivers and customer behavior patterns to design high-impact dashboards and analyses that anticipate stakeholder needs.

- Consistently delivers accurate, high-quality analyses within agreed timelines, maintaining data integrity standards that stakeholders trust for critical decisions.

- Development of clear, concise, and effective executive-level reporting and presentations.

- Successfully balances multiple high-priority projects in Vistra's dynamic retail energy environment, maintaining quality standards while adapting to shifting market conditions and business priorities.

What We Offer

- Collaborative culture where your AI-powered analyses drive strategic decisions impacting millions in revenue.

- Professional development budget for AI/ML and analytics certifications.

- Access to cutting-edge generative BI and analytics platforms, including but not limited to:
- BI Tools: Power BI, Tableau, Excel.

- Generative AI / BI Tools: Power BI Copilot, Tableau Pulse, Copilot, OpenAI Private Instance.

- Programming: Python, SQL, SAS.

- Web Analytics: Adobe Analytics.

- Databases / Platforms: Snowflake, Hana, Iguazio, and more.

- Collaboration: Working with data engineering, data science, technology and several business functions.

- Hybrid work flexibility with competitive salary and performance-based bonus opportunities.

- Clear career progression into more senior roles (e.g. Principal, Manager, and beyond).

- Comprehensive benefits including $0 premium health plan options, generous HSA contributions, 401(k) with full match on first 6%, fertility/adoption assistance, pet insurance, leading digital health tools, competitive PTO and paid holidays.

title: Air Permitting Senior Coordinator
description:
If you have what it takes to become part of the Vistra family and would like to start a promising career with a global leader, take a look at the exciting employment opportunities that are currently available and apply online.

Job Summary
The Air Permitting Senior Coordinator is responsible for leading the development, maintenance, interpretation, and strategic management of air permits necessary to support the operation and growth of electric power generation facilities. This role provides oversight of air permitting activities across assigned facilities and projects, including permitting strategy, regulatory review, consultant management, budget oversight, project prioritization, and coordination with plant, environmental, legal, engineering, and leadership teams. The position is accountable for ensuring air permitting work is completed in a timely, accurate, and cost-effective manner while managing regulatory risk, supporting operational flexibility, and providing routine status reporting to leadership.

Job Description
Key Accountabilities
• Lead and oversee the review and development of proposed projects related to construction, operation, repairs, and renovations to ensure compliance with federal, state, and local environmental regulations, including requirements to apply for and obtain timely preconstruction and operating permits.
• Manage existing preconstruction and operating air permits by ensuring permits are tracked, renewed, updated, and interpreted accurately to support ongoing plant operations and regulatory compliance.
• Develop and direct air permitting strategies for assigned facilities and projects, including evaluating permitting pathways, identifying regulatory risks, and supporting business decisions that preserve operational flexibility.
• Oversee the preparation, review, submittal, and agency support of air permit applications, registrations, notifications, permit amendments, and related regulatory filings required for construction, modification, and permit revisions.
• Provide oversight, direction, and prioritization for environmental team members, plant personnel, and outside consultants supporting air permitting efforts.
• Manage consultant scopes of work, deliverables, schedules, performance, and invoice review to ensure permitting support is accurate, timely, cost-effective, and aligned with company expectations. • Provide budget oversight for air permitting activities, including developing cost estimates, supporting annual budget planning, tracking expenditures, reviewing purchase orders and invoices, and communicating budget risks or variances to leadership.
• Prepare and deliver quarterly air permitting status reports that summarize key projects, permitting milestones, regulatory risks, consultant activity, budget status, upcoming deadlines, and issues requiring leadership awareness or direction.
• Track and evaluate environmental regulations related to air quality and permitting, assess potential impacts to Vistra facilities and operations, and provide recommendations to leadership and affected stakeholders.
• Ensure appropriate plant personnel and internal stakeholders understand applicable environmental obligations, permit requirements, project constraints, and compliance expectations.
• Review and provide oversight of environmental notifications, records, and reports, including those associated with Title V annual compliance certifications, annual emissions reports, NSPS, TRI, GHG, CEMS, allowance reports, MATS reports, deviation reports, and other quarterly or annual reports pursuant to air permitting and air regulatory requirements.
• Provide subject matter expertise and management support for compliance obligations associated with air permit requirements and air regulatory programs that impact assigned facilities.
• Participate in and support plant Compliance Assistance Visit directives, corrective action planning, and follow-up activities as necessary.
• Perform all other duties as assigned.

Education, Experience, and Skill Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, environmental engineering, engineering, or a related field preferred.
• Minimum of 7 years of experience in a corporate, agency, or consulting environment performing air permitting work and/or providing oversight of environmental regulatory compliance programs.
• Demonstrated experience leading air permitting projects, managing regulatory deliverables, and coordinating cross-functional teams or external consultants.
• Experience managing consultant scopes of work, project schedules, budgets, purchase orders, invoices, and performance expectations preferred.
• Experience preparing and presenting project status updates, regulatory summaries, budget information, and recommendations to multiple levels of responsibility within an organization, including field personnel, peers, senior management, clients, consultants, and other stakeholders.
• Ability to read, comprehend, and interpret complex environmental rules, regulations, permits, guidance, and agency correspondence.
• Strong leadership, communication, critical thinking, analytical, and decision-making skills.
• Self-motivated, organized, and able to perform well under pressure, prioritize competing workstreams, manage resources productively, and meet high-pressure deadlines across multiple projects.
